prompt: tell me what is psherical harmonics ?
response: Spherical harmonics are a set of functions defined on the surface of a sphere. They are the solutions to Laplace's equation in spherical coordinates and are used to represent functions defined on the surface of a sphere. Spherical harmonics are widely used in physics and engineering to describe the angular dependence of fields and waves. They form a complete set of orthogonal functions and can be used to represent any function on the sphere as a linear combination of these harmonics.
